verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a programmatic API with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, but nothing in the evidence describes API versioning or an API deprecation policy. The product-lifecycle migration pages for the Kubernetes agent and Beelines cover deprecated agents and SDKs, not versioned APIs, so they are only adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
